title: Tom's Free Time
text:
Tom likes to play football on Saturdays. He plays with his friends in the park near his house. They play for two hours. After the game, they sit on the grass and drink water.

On Sundays, Tom likes to read books. His favorite book is about a little dog. He reads in his room or in the garden. Reading makes him happy.

questions.text: What day does Tom play football?
What is Tom's favorite book about?
How does Tom probably feel after the football game?
Why does Tom probably like reading in the garden?
options: Because he does not like books
Because it is a quiet and pleasant place
Because it is always raining there

vocabulary.definition: a place with grass and trees where people can play and walk
the one that you like more than all the others
a piece of land next to a house where plants and flowers grow

paragraph_translations: Tom cumartesi günleri futbol oynamayı sever. Evinin yakınındaki parkta arkadaşlarıyla oynar. İki saat oynarlar. Maçtan sonra çimenlerin üzerinde oturur ve su içerler.
Pazar günleri Tom kitap okumayı sever. En sevdiği kitap küçük bir köpek hakkında. Odasında veya bahçede okur. Okumak onu mutlu eder.
